```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="sliding_cabinet">

  <!-- ==================== Main cabinet body ==================== -->
  <link name="cabinet_body">
    <!-- Inertial properties (approx. 120 kg solid wood) -->
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.84" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="120.0"/>
      <!-- Box inertia: Ixx = (1/12) m (h² + d²), Iyy = (1/12) m (w² + d²), Izz = (1/12) m (w² + h²) -->
      <inertia ixx="9.84" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="7.23" iyz="0.0"
               izz="6.84"/>
    </inertial>

    <!-- Visual geometry -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.84" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.09 0.58 1.68"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="oak">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.27 0.07 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>

    <!-- Collision geometry -->
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.84" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.09 0.58 1.68"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- ==================== Left sliding door ==================== -->
  <link name="door_left">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.84" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="30.0"/>
      <!-- Door dimensions: width 0.545 m, thickness 0.02 m, height 1.68 m -->
      <inertia ixx="0.84" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.12" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.86"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.84" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.545 0.02 1.68"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="glass">
        <color rgba="0.8 0.9 1.0 0.6"/>
      </material>
    </visual>

    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.84" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.545 0.02 1.68"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- ==================== Right sliding door ==================== -->
  <link name="door_right">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.84" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="30.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.84" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.12" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.86"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.84" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.545 0.02 1.68"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="glass">
        <color rgba="0.8 0.9 1.0 0.6"/>
      </material>
    </visual>

    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.84" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.545 0.02 1.68"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- ==================== Joints ==================== -->
  <!-- Left door slides on a track centred at -0.2725 m (half door width) -->
  <joint name="joint_left_door" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child link="door_left"/>
    <!-- Joint origin at the left inner edge of the cabinet (front face at -Y) -->
    <origin xyz="-0.2725 0 0.84" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/> <!-- slides along X -->
    <limit lower="-0.545" upper="0.0" effort="200" velocity="0.5"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.1"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Right door slides on a track centred at +0.2725 m -->
  <joint name="joint_right_door" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child link="door_right"/>
    <origin xyz="0.2725 0 0.84" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="0.545" effort="200" velocity="0.5"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.1"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
```
